quarterly_data.signal: Q3 2026 report, the company's explanation: growth came mainly from high-end AI PCB demand - high-layer HDI boards for new-generation rack-server compute and switch units, N+N high-layer boards and mSAP-type substrates for 800G and 1.6T optical modules - as downstream PCB makers kept investing heavily, and orders for all product lines grew sharply; the company follows an 'ALL IN AI' strategy and keeps expanding capacity; contract liabilities rose 150.94% to RMB 497,915,812.01 on higher advance payments and inventory rose 50.20% on more sales orders.
